channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: US Dollar: Carry trades supported as Fed seen on hold – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note that softer United States (US) Producer Price Index (PPI) and lower US Treasury yields have led markets to scale back expectations of a September Federal Reserve (Fed) hike, limiting US Dollar (USD) upside.

item.title: Euro flattens against Japanese Yen, ECB-BoJ to raise rates in September
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades flat at around 183.85 against the Japanese Yen (JPY) during the European trading session on Friday. The cross consolidates while investors seek fresh cues regarding whether there will be more United States (US)-Japan joint intervention to prop up the Japanese currency.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Shifting rate expectations and currency support – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur notes that Japanese government support for an imminent Bank of Japan rate hike has reinforced market expectations rather than surprised them. Probabilities now favor a hike as early as September, with October fully priced and another move in December possible.

item.title: Indian Rupee: RBI support offsets wider trade gap – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale notes India’s headline CPI rose slightly to 4.45% year-on-year in July, backing the RBI’s decision to keep policy unchanged. The central bank has reportedly been active in FX markets as the trade deficit widened.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Upside risk intact above support against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note AUD/USD is consolidating intraday between 0.7050 and 0.7075 after a brief spike to 0.7091 failed to build momentum.

item.title: Gold recovers intraday losses as reduced Fed hike bets offset geopolitics and weigh on USD
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) finds decent support ahead of the $4,300 mark and recovers a major part of its intraday losses during the first half of the European session on Friday.

item.title: Brent: Geopolitical premium eases after six-day rally – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank analysts highlight that Brent Oil has finally broken a six-day winning streak, with prices pulling back modestly as some geopolitical risk premium is removed.

item.title: Japanese Yen recovers from two-week low on fast BoJ rate hike bets, softer USD
item.description: The USD/JPY pair sticks to modest intraday losses through the first half of the European session on Friday, though it manages to hold above the 159.00 mark and remains close to a two-week top set the previous day.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Hawkish ECB prospects support Euro
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades 0.17% higher at around 1.1550 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Friday. The major currency pair gains as the Euro rises due to firm expectations that the European Central Bank (ECB) will raise interest rates in the policy meeting in September.

item.title: US Dollar: Softer tone with falling yields – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes the US Dollar (USD) is trading on a softer footing as Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike expectations are scaled back following weaker labour data and a mixed United States (US) Producer Price Index (PPI) report.

item.title: Australian Dollar bounces up, US Dollar droops ahead of US Retail Sales data
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) is trading a tad firmer against the Dollar (USD) on Friday, fuelled by hawkish remarks by Reserve Bank of Australia’s (RBA) Assistant Governor, Chris Kent.

item.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ tightening debate supports JPY – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank strategist Elwin de Groot highlights that Japanese policymakers are increasingly focused on achieving the inflation target sustainably and supporting the Japanese Yen. Following recent FX intervention, He argues that exchange-rate management ultimately needs monetary policy backing.

item.title: Norwegian Krone: Weaker after Norges Bank holds rates – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team notes that Norges Bank left its policy rate at 4.25% and kept a tightening bias despite weaker summer inflation. They still expect one final hike in September, though the odds have fallen and the decision is now finely balanced.

item.title: Canadian Dollar hits fresh high since June on rising oil prices, Fed-inspired USD weakness
item.description: The USD/CAD pair extends the previous day's decline from the top end of the weekly range and attracts follow-through selling for the second straight day.

item.title: Dow Jones futures steady ahead of US Retail Sales data
item.description: Dow Jones futures remain subdued around 53,910 during European hours on Friday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures move little, hovering around 7,820, and Nasdaq 100 futures inch lower by 0.09%, trading near 30,160.

item.title: British Pound: Locked in tight ranges against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann report GBP/USD price action remains confined, with intraday moves seen between 1.3475 and 1.3515 as momentum has faded.

item.title: Euro: Showing some undervaluation against US Dollar – ING
item.description: ING FX Strategist Francesco Pesole highlights that EUR/USD appears modestly undervalued, with short-term fair value estimated around 1.160–1.1650 based on swap spreads.

item.title: Indian Rupee trades calm while approaching the weekend
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens on a flat note at around 95.40 against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday.

item.title: Equities: US stock rally broadens as S&P 500 hits new high – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists report that United States (US) equities, led by the S&P 500, have reached new record highs as softer inflation data and lower Oil prices reinforce expectations that the Fed can stay on hold.

item.title: Canadian Dollar gathers strength on easing Fed rate hike bets
item.description: The USD/CAD pair attracts some sellers to around 1.3910 during the early European trading hours on Friday. The US Dollar (USD) weakens against the Canadian Dollar (CAD) as cooled US inflation data have tempered aggressive Federal Reserve (Fed) rate-hike bets.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar gains on hawkish RBNZ policy outlook
item.description: NZD/USD gains ground after four days of losses, trading around 0.5870 during the early European hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the New Zealand Dollar (NZD) receives support from traders continuing to price in a Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) rate hike next month.

item.title: British Pound edges down against Japanese Yen on hawkish BoJ bets
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) faces mild selling pressure against the Japanese Yen (JPY) during the European trading session on Friday.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Recovery needs faster BoJ normalisation – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note that September Bank of Japan (BoJ) hike expectations have risen sharply, but the Japanese Yen (JPY) has reacted only modestly.

item.title: Forex Today: Easing Fed rate hike bets weigh on USD amid Mideast stalemate
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Friday, August 14:

item.title: US Dollar: Labor slowdown gives mixed signals for Dollar - Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur and Tatha Ghose highlight that despite a “low-hire, low-fire” US labor market, the Dollar remains supported. Initial jobless claims and unemployment stay very low, while wage growth shows only tentative signs of slowing.

item.title: Euro edges up against British Pound but remains within recent ranges
item.description: The Euro (EUR) is trading practically flat against the British Pound (GBP) on Friday, holding moderate gains after bouncing from three-week lows on Thursday. The EUR/GBP pair, however, is struggling to find significant acceptance above 0.8550, and remains on track for a 0.2% weekly loss.

item.title: Euro: Higher intraday band within broader range against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight that EUR/USD is consolidating after a brief spike, with the pair expected to trade intraday in a slightly higher 1.1515–1.1550 range as the underlying tone firms.

item.title: BoJ set to hike rates as soon as September— Reuters
item.description: The Bank of Japan (BoJ) is set to raise interest rates as soon as September and is likely to hike more aggressively thereafter from the current pace of roughly twice a year, three sources familiar with its thinking told Reuters.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD slips below $64.00 on profit taking
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its losses for the second consecutive day, trading around $63.50 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Friday.

item.title: WTI regains ground near $80 amid continued energy supply risks
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), futures on NYMEX, trades 0.4% higher around $81.40 during the early European trading session on Friday.
